test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined words.

I do not like him because he __always disapproves the things or opinions of others.__
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term **"critical of others"** refers to someone who frequently finds faults or disapproves of others' actions, opinions, or behavior. (दूसरों की आलोचना करने वाला) • **Example: **John is often critical of his coworkers' efforts, pointing out their mistakes instead of appreciating their hard work. • **"Disapproves"** means to have an unfavorable opinion about something. (अस्वीकृत करना) • **Example: **She **disapproves** of his way of handling the project. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Insensitive of others' feelings **(दूसरों की भावनाओं के प्रति असंवेदनशील): Not showing care or concern for other people's feelings. • **Example:** His insensitive comments during the meeting upset many of his colleagues. • **Hate monger **(घृणा फैलाने वाला): A person who promotes hatred and hostility. • **Example: **The politician was labeled as a hate monger for his divisive speeches. • **Jealous of other people** (दूसरे लोगों से ईर्ष्या करना): Feeling or showing envy of someone for their achievements and advantages. • **Example:** She was jealous of her friend’s success in the business. 3e0:Tb89, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
